title: introduce-variant-deprecation-crosswalk-and-compact-release-summary
author: Priya Sethi
description:
Motivation: When we retire model variants (quantized/INT8/FP16 variants) teams need a concise migration brief that combines performance delta, compatibility notes, and provenance assertions so downstream consumers can plan rollouts. Current onboarding flow produces separate artifacts (profile JSONs, changelog drafts, and manual migration notes) which increases churn and leads to inconsistent deprecation messaging. This PR introduces a lightweight crosswalk that maps deprecated variants to replacement candidates and an automated compact release summary generator that synthesizes perf deltas, profile metadata, and a provenance signature into a short brief suitable for release notes and automated notifications.

What this changes: single continuous description of changes below (implementation, docs, tests, and automation hooks).

- Add variant_crosswalk.py: a small utility that builds a mapping table from model profiles, metadata tags (compatibility/affordances), and historical rollout signals (usage buckets) to propose replacement variants when a variant is marked for deprecation. The crosswalk exposes a narrow JSON API consumed by the release summary generator.
- Add release_summary generator (pkg/summary/compact_summary.go + CLI wrapper): consumes one or more profile snapshots and a crosswalk proposal and emits a compact markdown and machine-readable summary. Includes perf delta buckets (latency/throughput/cost-per-token) and compatibility footnotes (tokenizer/runtime hooks).
- Provenance signer: small integration that attaches a lightweight provenance signature (SHA256 over canonical profile + deploy manifest) so release consumers can verify the brief is derived from on-chain-like canonical artifacts. Signature is stored as an additional key in the summary.
- Docs: docs/onboarding/variant-deprecation.md explains the crosswalk heuristics, rolling strategy recommendations, and example release brief templates.
- Tests: unit tests for crosswalk heuristics, integration test for summary generation, and negative tests for malformed profiles.
- CI: adds a fast lint + unit job for the Python crosswalk and a Go unit test job for the summary generator.

Checklist: 
- [x] Crosswalk algorithm implemented with deterministic output for identical inputs
- [x] Summary generator produces both markdown and JSON output
- [x] Provenance signature implemented and verified by tests
- [x] Docs and example briefs included
- [x] Basic CI coverage added

Small illustrative snippets included inline in the summary docs (short examples only): the summary generator emits a top-line table of perf deltas and a short compatibility note referencing tokenizer changes and required runtime flags. Examples in docs use the generated brief for a hypothetical deprecation of model 'gpt-lite-int8' recommending 'gpt-lite-fp16' as replacement with expected +12ms median latency and -35% cost-per-token.

Review conversation (high level timeline and excerpts): 
- Diego Ramirez (requested changes 2025-11-14): "Crosswalk looks good, but heuristics should include a hard rule to avoid recommending replacements with differing tokenizer families. Please add tokenizer family checks and a test case where candidate is disqualified."
- Priya Sethi (author reply 2025-11-15): "Added tokenizer-family check and test fixture (see test/fixtures/tokenizer-family-mismatch.json). Also added a small logging metric for disqualified candidates to help audit decisions."
- Marissa Cheng (comment 2025-11-16): "Can the release summary include a short migration command snippet for infra teams?"
- Priya Sethi (author reply 2025-11-16): "Added example CLI snippet to the markdown template and a short Ansible play snippet in the docs appendix."
- Alexei Volkov (approval 2025-11-19): "Approving — tests pass locally and summary output is clear. Consider follow-up to wire into our alerting bot for automated deprecation notices."

CI summary: initial run had a flaky Go test (timing-dependent) which was fixed by normalizing the test's timing windows. Final CI run shows all checks passing: python-lint (pass), python-unit (pass), go-unit (pass), docs-links (pass).

Merge: squash and merge with manual merge commit. Added release note snippet and linked Linear tasks to the merge commit.

release_notes: Introduce automated variant deprecation crosswalk and compact release summary generator. Adds deterministic replacement recommendations, perf delta reporting, and provenance signatures for concise migration briefs. Includes docs and CI coverage. Will be used to generate deprecation notices and release notes for model variant retirements.
notes_for_followup: Follow-up tasks: wire summary output to deprecation-notice-bot (ENG-2551), add telemetry dashboard for disqualified candidates and recommended replacements, and add a scheduled job to produce weekly deprecation candidate reports.
example_brief_key_snippet:
Model: gpt-lite-int8
Recommended replacement: gpt-lite-fp16
Perf delta: +12ms median latency, -35% cost-per-token
Compatibility notes: tokenizer-family match OK; requires runtime flag --enable-fp16
Provenance: sha256:3f7b9a...
technical_risks: Heuristic misrecommendation if profiles are stale; mitigated by requiring recent profile timestamps and usage-weighted votes. Provenance signature assumes canonical profile storage. Follow-up: integrate with profile freshness checker and add summary TTL metadata.
